verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing showing VirtualPostMail publishes any source code or uses an open license. Its developer resources are closed and contact-gated: API documentation is available only on request, and the API host returns 401.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
